export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"; export KAGGLE_API_TOKEN="KGAT_60050eb732f8deb448367144c378a69c"; timeout 90 python3 - <<'PY'
import requests,os
H={"Authorization":f"Bearer {os.environ['KAGGLE_API_TOKEN']}"}
for u in ["https://www.kaggle.com/api/v1/kernels/list?user=me&pageSize=3",
          "https://www.kaggle.com/api/v1/kernels/list?group=profile&user=me",
          "https://www.kaggle.com/api/v1/users/list?pageSize=1"]:
    r=requests.get(u,headers=H,timeout=30)
    print(u.split("/api/v1/")[1][:45],"->",r.status_code,r.text[:150].replace("\n"," "))
